name: The Strange Case of Mei Lysel Andi
source:
My old friend asked me to meet at her place, but it seems she's gonna be late and has invited me to read this unlabeled book that's just left on the table

[from [url=https://honeyshroomsw.itch.io/the-strange-case-of-mei-lysel-andi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我的老朋友约我去她家见面，但她似乎要迟到了，并邀请我看这本刚刚留在桌子上的没有标签的书

[来自[url=https://honeyshroomsw.itch.io/the-strange-case-of-mei-lysel-andi]itch.io[/url]]
